# Life After 40

> > Evidence-based fitness, nutrition, and recovery guidance for professionals over 40 to combat sarcopenia, optimize longevity, and thrive in midlife.

Founded by Philip Blackett, Life After 40 provides science-backed strategies for strength training, muscle recovery, and sustainable wellness specifically designed for the physiological changes that occur after 40. The site emphasizes functional fitness, anti-inflammatory nutrition, and recovery optimization to help midlife adults maintain vitality and purpose.

## Key Topics

- Sarcopenia prevention
- Strength training after 40
- Muscle recovery strategies
- Active vs passive recovery
- Functional fitness
- Age-related fitness adaptations
- Midlife wellness
- Sleep optimization
- Injury prevention
- Self-Determination Theory (SDT)
- WOOP Method
- Recovery technology (Oura Ring, Theragun, Eight Sleep)
- Anti-inflammatory nutrition
- Longevity and aging
- Middlescence and purpose

## Getting Started

- [Life After 40 ™ | Thrive in the Second Half of Life.](https://lifeafter40.com): Homepage: Philip's mission to help 40+ adults master nutrition & fitness
- [About | Life After 40](https://lifeafter40.com/about): Philip Blackett's founder story and midlife wellness transformation journey
- [Who We Fight For: Our Manifesto](https://lifeafter40.com/post/who-we-fight-for): Mission manifesto for midlife professionals reclaiming health and vitality

## Strength Training After 40

- [The Safest Way to Start Strength Training in Your 40s](https://lifeafter40.com/post/the-safest-way-to-start-strength-training-in-your-40s): Beginner-safe strength training guide following CDC and ACSM guidelines
- [How to Build Functional Strength for Daily Life After 40](https://lifeafter40.com/post/how-to-build-functional-strength-for-daily-life-after-40): Functional strength guide with compound movements to prevent sarcopenia
- [Cardio Alone Isn't Working Anymore — Why Strength Training Becomes Essential After 40](https://lifeafter40.com/post/cardio-alone-isn-t-working-anymore-why-strength-training-becomes-essential-after-40): Why resistance training beats cardio for metabolism and sarcopenia prevention
- [Too Sore, Too Tired, or Always Injured? Signs Your Workout Isn't Built for 40+](https://lifeafter40.com/post/too-sore-too-tired-or-always-injured-signs-your-workout-isn-t-built-for-40): Identifying overtraining signs and age-appropriate workout adjustments

## Recovery & Muscle Optimization

- [The Importance of Recovery After 40 (and How to Do It Right)](https://lifeafter40.com/post/the-importance-of-recovery-after-40): Science-backed recovery strategies for muscle repair and longevity after 40
- [Active vs. Passive Recovery: What You Need After 40](https://lifeafter40.com/post/active-vs-passive-recovery-what-you-need-after-40): Balancing active movement and rest to combat DOMS and muscle loss
- [How to Prioritize Recovery Without Feeling Lazy After 40](https://lifeafter40.com/post/how-to-prioritize-recovery-without-feeling-lazy-after-40): Reframing recovery as proactive health strategy for combating sarcopenia
- [How to Use Technology to Improve Your Rest and Recovery After 40](https://lifeafter40.com/post/how-to-use-technology-to-improve-your-rest-and-recovery-after-40): Recovery tech guide: Oura Ring, Theragun, Eight Sleep Pod & red light therapy

## Mindset & Purpose

- [How to Set Goals That Actually Motivate You After 40](https://lifeafter40.com/post/how-to-set-goals-that-actually-motivate-you-after-40): Goal-setting using Self-Determination Theory and WOOP Method for midlife
- [How to Rediscover Your Purpose After 40](https://lifeafter40.com/post/how-to-rediscover-your-purpose-after-40): Neuroscience-backed strategies for finding purpose during middlescence
- [Why Willpower Isn't the Problem After 40](https://lifeafter40.com/post/why-willpower-isn-t-the-problem-after-40): Building sustainable habits by overcoming decision fatigue, not willpower
